description: This file defines the base interface 'OpenmrsObject' for all classes in the OpenMRS project, providing methods for getting and setting a unique identifier and UUID.

classes.name: OpenmrsObject
classes.description: A base interface for all OpenMRS-defined classes, providing methods for getting and setting identifiers and UUIDs.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the object.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the object.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Returns the universally unique identifier (UUID) for the object.

methods.name: setUuid
methods.description: Sets the UUID for the object.
